template: group_normalize(ts_decay_linear(multiply(trade_when(or(greater(group_rank(winsorize(ts_backfill({concentration},63),std=4), industry), 0.85), less(group_rank(winsorize(ts_backfill({concentration},63),std=4), industry), 0.15)), signed_power(group_zscore(winsorize(ts_backfill({concentration},63),std=4), industry), 2), NaN), group_zscore(winsorize(ts_backfill({nondomicile},63),std=4), industry)), 10), industry)
idea: 极端分位双向择时：利用group_rank截留行业内地域集中度处于前15%（极高依赖）或后15%（极度分散）的标的，中间70%视为无信号（NaN）；对极端值进行非线性放大（signed_power），并与海外收入标准化因子交互，构建针对“异常地理集中风险”的尾部策略。
